summary: PO 2024 section 11: the minor is four compulsory module exams totaling 40 credits. Politikwissenschaft majors take Methoden der Datenerhebung II (12 credits) and Methoden der Datenanalyse II (6 credits); every other major takes Methoden der Datenerhebung (12 credits) and Methoden der Datenanalyse I (6 credits). Einführung in die Soziologie (7 credits) and Soziologische Diagnose (15 credits) are compulsory in both plans and are not choice categories. Section 11 cites these plans as Anlage 5 and Anlage 7; the table of contents numbers them Anlage 4 and Anlage 6.
